title: Printing to console.
description:
## Printing

To print to console, there is only one prerequisit, importing the `fmt` package. I'll explain importing later, but all you need to know is right after `package`, you import fmt with `import "fmt"`. To actually print to console, you use the syntax `fmt.Println("Text here")`. It prints a line to console, it's just that simple.
